title: The state of AI in 2026 On the road to ROI
locator: Key takeaways; Use of AI is deepening; About the research
claim: 40% of respondents at organizations with revenue above USD1 billion report scaling agents in one or more functions; 22% at smaller organizations. Survey: 1,719 participants, 97 nations, national GDP response weighting.
limit: Respondent self-report, not a probability estimate for every firm. One or more functions is not enterprise-wide scaling; neither is chart-review use or a finance-peer diffusion denominator. Fieldwork is not October 2026 deployment. No S-curve is fitted.
short_source_excerpt: The online survey was in the field from May 4 to June 8, 2026

title: Large Firms With at Least 20 Employees Biggest AI Users
locator: BTOS question wording and AI Trends Across Sectors
claim: For the period ending May 3, 2026, any-AI use was 33.9% in Finance and Insurance and 19.8% nationally; the core question asks about use in the past two weeks in any business function.
limit: US employer-business any-AI measure, not integrated agentic systems or chart-review deployment. The revised November 2025 wording prevents a naive continuous comparison with earlier production-only questions. Expectations are not observed future use. This is a dated comparison, not the latest October release.
short_source_excerpt: Whether the business used AI in the past two weeks.
